statement: theorem dot_add {C K : Type} [CommRing K] (columns : List C) (r s z : C → K) : dot columns (fun c => r c + s c) z = dot columns r z + dot columns s z
theorem dot_scale {C K : Type} [CommRing K] (columns : List C) (u : K) (r z : C → K) : dot columns (fun c => u * r c) z = u * dot columns r z
theorem swap_kernel_iff {I C K : Type} [DecidableEq I] [CommRing K] (columns : List C) (M : I → C → K) (z : C → K) (a b : I) (hab : a ≠ b) : Kernel columns (swapRows M a b) z ↔ Kernel columns M z

theorem scale_kernel_iff {I C K : Type} [DecidableEq I] [CommRing K] (columns : List C) (M : I → C → K) (z : C → K) (a : I) (u v : K) (unit : u * v = 1) : Kernel columns (scaleRow M a u) z ↔ Kernel columns M z

theorem add_kernel_iff {I C K : Type} [DecidableEq I] [CommRing K] (columns : List C) (M : I → C → K) (z : C → K) (dst src : I) (u : K) (different : dst ≠ src) : Kernel columns (addRow M dst src u) z ↔ Kernel columns M z
theorem operation_kernel_iff {I C K : Type} [DecidableEq I] [CommRing K] (columns : List C) (M : I → C → K) (z : C → K) (op : Elementary I K) : Kernel columns (applyOp op M) z ↔ Kernel columns M z

theorem finite_trace_kernel_iff {I C K : Type} [DecidableEq I] [CommRing K] (columns : List C) (M : I → C → K) (z : C → K) (ops : List (Elementary I K)) : Kernel columns (replay ops M) z ↔ Kernel columns M z

theorem one_free_column_proportional {C K : Type} [CommRing K] (z w coefficient : C → K) (free : C) (inverse : K) (unit : w free * inverse = 1) (zrows : ∀ c, c ≠ free → z c + coefficient c * z free = 0) (wrows : ∀ c, c ≠ free → w c + coefficient c * w free = 0) : ∀ c, z c = (z free * inverse) * w c

theorem conditional_three_descent_ratio {J K : Type} [CommRing K] (addJ : J → J → J) (scalar : K → J → J) (character : J → K) (additive : ∀ x y, character (addJ x y) = character x + character y) (linear : ∀ a x, character (scalar a x) = a * character x) (R G Q : J) (k multiplier offset y0 y1 y2 inverse : K) (target : Q = scalar k G) (first : y0 = multiplier * character R - offset) (second : y1 = multiplier * character (addJ R G) - offset) (third : y2 = multiplier * character (addJ R Q) - offset) (unit : (y1 - y0) * inverse = 1) : (y2 - y0) * inverse = k
